sentences.text:
Khasti Ballabh Pandey @ Karan Pandey And ... vs State Of U.P.
And Another on 19 January, 2023
Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh
Bench: Saumitra Dayal Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 64
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 33133 of 2022
Applicant :- Khasti Ballabh Pandey @ Karan Pandey And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Kumar Upadhyay
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Sri Shivam Shukla, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Vinod Kumar, learned counsel
for the opposite party no. 2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

This application under Section - 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the entire proceeding of Case No.10737 of 2021 arising out of case crime no.45 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and u/s 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Meerut, pending in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division) FTC (Crime Against Women) Meerut.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division) FTC (Crime Against Women) Meerut
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Submission of the learned counsel for the applicants is, parties i.e. applicant no. 1 and opposite party no. 2 were involved in matrimonial discord.
It gave rise to the present prosecution.

It is further submitted, no real occurrence took place and no offence was ever committed.

entities.text: Khasti Ballabh Pandey @ Karan Pandey And ... vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In any case, it has further been submitted, the parties have been able to resolve their disputes and differences such that they are living in matrimony without any dispute surviving.
In such circumstances, it has been submitted, present prosecution may be dropped as its pendency may be counter producted to the resolution already executed.
5. Considering the above, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the present application pending any further.

The entire proceedings of Case No.10737 of 2021 arising out of case crime no.45 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and u/s 3/4 D.P. Act,
P.S. Mahila Thana, District Meerut, pending in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division) FTC (Crime Against Women) Meerut, are hereby quashed.
